task: Get ready to pick stuff up and put it in places, because you've just entered TextWorld! Here is how to play! First stop, move north. After that, make an attempt to take a trip west. With that over with, make an effort to take a trip west. And then, travel south. With that accomplished, move south. With that over with, go east. And then, head south. And then, head east. After that, go to the south. With that over with, travel east. And then, attempt to move north. If you can finish that, try to go east. And then, make an effort to go to the north. Then, lift the pen from the floor of the workshop. Alright, thanks!
